body:
### Description

I found that `jax.numpy.linalg.tensorinv` brings different results with `numpy.linalg.tensorinv` in following case.
I suppose this may be a bug in `JAX`.

```py
import numpy as np
import jax.numpy as jnp

print(np.linalg.tensorinv(np.full((2, 2), np.nan), 1))
print(jnp.linalg.tensorinv(jnp.full((2, 2), jnp.nan), 1))
```
Output:
```bash
[[nan nan]
 [nan nan]]
[[nan nan]
 [nan inf]]
```
